short_label: ST. V VS. LUTHERAN WEST / BOYS BASKETBALL
article_headline: STVM Rallies in Second Half to Beat Lutheran West 54–46
article_dek: Leigh Cotton scores 14 as the Fighting Irish erase a halftime deficit and finish strong.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — St. Vincent–St. Mary overturned a five-point halftime deficit to defeat Lutheran West 54–46 on December 16, 2025. The Irish were down 28–23 at the break before their defense and balanced offense shifted the direction of the game.

STVM outscored the Longhorns 31–18 over the final two quarters, turning the early deficit into an eight-point win. The turnaround was built on stronger defensive play and contributions from multiple seniors.

Leigh Cotton led the Irish with 14 points. DeCarlo Prince and Caleb Hill each added 11, according to the school's game report. The result gave the Irish a confidence-building win during the December schedule.

Summit County Sports’ photographs present a courtside view of the players and key moments from the game.
article_highlights: St. Vincent–St. Mary trailed Lutheran West 28–23 at halftime.
The Irish outscored the Longhorns 31–18 after halftime to take an eight-point victory.
Leigh Cotton paced STVM with 14 points; DeCarlo Prince and Caleb Hill scored 11 apiece.
